subject: reasoning
question: P + Q means P is the husband of Q, P - Q means P is the sister of Q, P × Q means P is the mother of Q. Then what does A × B + C mean?
solution:

 Symbol

 ×
 
 

 Meaning

 Sister

Given: A × B + C

It means:

A is the Mother of B

B is the Husband of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc4aad816df9e206bd9dc6fac80cf33f0ca0645c98481031df1a7fefa9534fb.png] 

So, A is the **mother-in-law of C**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
